title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
tip: Node with children map and is_word flag.
statement:
Implement a trie with `insert(word)`, `search(word)`, and `startsWith(prefix)`.

`search` returns true only for a full word. `startsWith` is a prefix query.
constraints: word and prefix consist of lowercase English letters.
editorial: Each node: dict child, bool end. Walk characters.
